acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves that missing canonical journey authority blocks design; it does not ratify any particular journey.
evidenceRequired: A mature-repository fixture without a canonical journey produces MISSING-CANONICAL-JOURNEY and design LOCKED.
A repository-native canonical index binds an explicitly linked journey only after the source is tracked and recognized.

completionCriteria: A mature repository without a defined canonical journey cannot be marked MAPPED, coherent, or design ready.
Feature fragments and incidental journey language do not satisfy canonical journey authority.
An explicit authority declaration or repository-native canonical index can bind the repository's existing journey model without installing a competing authority.
The repository owner must ratify or revise the canonical journey before the gate unlocks.
nonObjectives: Do not create a generic journey that outranks the consuming repository.
Do not treat a proposed or untracked journey as canonical.
Do not unlock design from journey keywords alone.
objective: Make canonical journey authority a mandatory, owner-ratified prerequisite for material design work.
title: Block design without a canonical journey
